server/model-manifest/schema.ts.name: Manifest zod schema
server/model-manifest/schema.ts.description: Validates the model manifest with per-engine id rules, unique ids, a current default and price entries.

server/model-manifest/bundled.ts.name: Bundled manifest loader
server/model-manifest/bundled.ts.description: Parses the bundled manifest strictly at load and converts an engine section into a picker catalog.

server/model-manifest/manifest.ts.name: Manifest refresh store
server/model-manifest/manifest.ts.description: Downloads the manifest from GitHub hourly, caches it on disk, and gates models by installed CLI version.

server/model-manifest/wiring.test.ts.name: Manifest wiring test
server/model-manifest/wiring.test.ts.description: Checks that drivers pick up a newer cached manifest when they load.

server/model-catalog/catalog.ts.name: models.dev catalog store
server/model-catalog/catalog.ts.description: Chooses the newest of own cache, OpenCode cache and bundled snapshot, and refreshes from models.dev daily.

server/model-catalog/trim.ts.name: models.dev catalog trimmer
server/model-catalog/trim.ts.description: Reduces models.dev data to tool-calling models, dropping entries with braces, and packs or unpacks it.

server/model-catalog/presets.ts.name: Provider presets
server/model-catalog/presets.ts.description: Pins base URLs and key-check paths for recommended OpenAI-compatible providers so refreshes cannot redirect keys.

scripts/build-model-catalog.mjs.name: Catalog snapshot builder
scripts/build-model-catalog.mjs.description: Builds the models.dev snapshot file from api.json and verifies the committed copy.

server/default-model-selection.ts.name: Default model selection
server/default-model-selection.ts.description: Picks a new bot's engine and model by ranking available engines, never switching provider silently.

server/drivers/codex-catalog.ts.name: Codex model catalog
server/drivers/codex-catalog.ts.description: Lists OpenAI models via codex app-server, falls back to a static list, and merges config.toml providers.

server/drivers/pi-catalog.ts.name: Pi model catalog
server/drivers/pi-catalog.ts.description: Parses Pi's get_available_models frame into provider-qualified custom model options.

server/hosted-models.ts.name: Hosted model policy
server/hosted-models.ts.description: Restricts selectable models to a company-assigned catalog and routes engines through a gateway.

server/model-context-window.ts.name: Context window guess
server/model-context-window.ts.description: Estimates a model's context window from its id when the catalog gives none.

server/model-prices.ts.name: List price lookup
server/model-prices.ts.description: Resolves dated list prices and estimates turn cost from operator, list or reported prices.

server/prices.ts.name: Operator price list
server/prices.ts.description: Defines operator sell prices and computes the billable amount for a turn.

server/startup-model-catalog.ts.name: Startup model cache
server/startup-model-catalog.ts.description: Persists each engine's model list on disk and refreshes it in the background at start.

server/routes/thread-models.ts.name: Thread model route
server/routes/thread-models.ts.description: Handles POST follow-model to move threads with their own model back to the bot's model.

server/routes/internal-models.ts.name: Agent model menu
server/routes/internal-models.ts.description: Builds the compact per-engine model menu a bot sees, with efforts, blocked models and connect hints.

server/drivers/claude-model-access.ts.name: Claude org model blocks
server/drivers/claude-model-access.ts.description: Reads the account's modelAccessCache to flag organization-blocked models and notes model swaps.

server/drivers/claude-model-extras.ts.name: Claude model extras
server/drivers/claude-model-extras.ts.description: Adds custom models from settings.json and env to the Claude list and builds endpoint catalogs.

server/agent-endpoint-models.ts.name: Endpoint model discovery
server/agent-endpoint-models.ts.description: Lists official models or fetches a gateway's /models over safe HTTP with size and id limits.

server/thread-model.ts.name: Thread model fallback
server/thread-model.ts.description: Decides when a thread's own model falls back because its engine is unavailable or signed out.

shared/thread-model.ts.name: Thread model helpers
shared/thread-model.ts.description: Compares model selections and finds threads running on a model other than the bot's.

server/model-requests.ts.name: Model change requests
server/model-requests.ts.description: Validates a model proposal and builds the owner approval card for changing a bot's default.

shared/ai-ranking.ts.name: AI ranking
shared/ai-ranking.ts.description: Ranks engines Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Grok, then others for a new bot's default.

packages/phone-protocol/src/effort-level.name: Effort level lookup
packages/phone-protocol/src/effort-level.description: Returns a model's offered effort levels, preferring model over engine defaults.

src/lib/model-choices.ts.name: Picker model choices
src/lib/model-choices.ts.description: Expands variants into picker rows, applies a pick to a selection and offers typed OpenCode ids.
